description: This file defines the AuthenticationController class for handling user authentication in the SuiteCRM project. It manages login, session validation, and logout processes, and dynamically loads specific authentication method classes based on configuration and context.

classes.name: AuthenticationController
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing user authentication, including login, session validation, and logout processes within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the authentication controller object based on specified type or configuration.

methods.name: getAuthController
methods.description: Private method that determines and loads the appropriate authentication class file based on the type and context.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method implementing singleton pattern to return a single instance of AuthenticationController.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login attempts, authenticates credentials, and manages post-login workflows and redirects.

methods.name: sessionAuthenticate
methods.description: Validates the current session for an authenticated user, updating session stats if valid.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user, invoking pre- and post-logout logic hooks and invalidating the session.
